summary: The published public head Papercusp/papercusp-app@3c1ed9a1d7ddf2823f4892e94516c9f8b519d80c (tree d44db83c0b291570ac67c70f9ed927be3b78166a) carries MANIFEST.source = Papercusp/papercup@d20b360237373f31326a9ba287086b625dd8624d, the same source the export-gate receipt pushed. Its dependency graph follows the pinned objects: all 12 shipped lockfiles are byte-identical (blob ids) to the pinned source resolved through gitlinks; the 37 MANIFEST submodule pins equal the 37 shipped gitlinks of d20b3602 (the 38th, libs/generic/prospect-contract, is declared notShipped and has 0 files in the cut); 0 gitlink entries and 0 node_modules paths are shipped across 16275 entries. A fresh isolated re-export of d20b3602 into /tmp produced the identical 16275-path set with no dependency-file differences, and left the shared tree's HEAD, branch, submodule pins and export-related status untouched. It did not reproduce the tree byte-for-byte: 86 non-dependency files differ in identity-scrub output, a regression in today's exporter filed as WI-10006500 (it does not affect the published cut).
